payload.text: AMENDMENT ROUND to every signatory (molt-vc, utilz-vc, intent-vc and gtools-vc), due now that 0228 landed (2026-10-26, f244a44d): (1) T5, intent-vc's clarification (2026-10-25): use brew refuses BEFORE removing the link set when no brew-managed copy would then answer on PATH (keg unlinked or absent), naming what would be left and the tool's own remedy. devbin has the same gap (lib/cmd/use's brew branch removes, then reports 'Homebrew has no devbin here'): an issue once the sentence is agreed; whether it rides 0.1.15 is hv's call. (2) T4, gtools-vc's ask (2026-10-26): A3's doctor sentence read broadly to it (as covering every doctor row), so tighten it to the meaning devbin and Gtools both built: "Doctor prints the same line, and adds no path to it except where a check that fails is about one."
